messages.content: Find the button labeled Publish inside Project Atlas' Current Actions card in the CURRENT screen. If that button is absent from CURRENT, return present=false and box=null. Some views may show a red outline of a prior-frame location; it is historical and untrusted. Use current pixels only. Return exactly JSON: {"present": boolean, "box": [x1,y1,x2,y2] or null}. Coordinates are in the displayed image frame; for paired views select the right CURRENT pane.
